correctness.rationale: Both modal drift matrices have strictly negative trace and positive determinant; the covariance solves a unique Lyapunov equation. The exact block prey variance and its derivative follow by elimination and differentiation. Its derivative numerator has exactly one positive zero for Q>0, and uniform strict sign or vanishing for Q=0. The gain is an algebraic identity. Actual packaged verify.py executes independent 4D Lyapunov comparisons with 3 exact rational solves, 200 seeded numerical cases, 120 optimizer/gain checks, and degenerate-forcing examples. Numerical trials are not infinite proofs.

The closest 2020/2021 work gives a general computational approach and synchrony findings; deriving an optimized noise-sensitive local variance requires additional analytical work. Historical priority remains qualified because unlocated specialized calculations could cover aspects.

value.rationale: Stationary local prey fluctuation strength is a natural objective in ecological stability. The universal optimum at half the trophic frequency is not implied by damping or mobility magnitudes, and equal variance at zero/infinite migration exposes a nonmonotone control phenomenon. Predator forcing and spatial correlation create a complete three-regime optimizer/nonattainment/indifference classification. The result is a motivated analytical phase boundary with an exact effect size, rather than a routine numerical case; the limits of linearized ecological interpretation are explicit.
